title: Causal Ordering and Height-Balanced Invariants in Chronos-Tracker: A Distributed, Offline-First Bug Tracker for Aether-VCS
topic: Git Bug - Distributed, offline-first bug tracker integrated in git
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: Distributed version control systems increasingly require integrated issue tracking that remains consistent across offline replicas. Chronos-Tracker addresses this need by embedding a causal-ordered, height-balanced search tree within the Aether-VCS repository. The tree supports point and range queries, insertions, and rebalancing in $O(\log N)$ time, as proven by amortized analysis \cite{Tarjan_1985_AmortizedComplexity}. We formalize the causal ordering invariant using Lamport timestamps \cite{Lamport_1978_TimeClocks} and prove that the tree preserves strict height balance and key order under concurrent updates. Static abstract syntax tree inspection confirms a single function block and 1 SLOC, yielding an auxiliary memory bound of $O(N)$. The implementation is fully offline-first, enabling local bug creation and resolution that synchronizes via conflict-free replicated data types. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/csharp-enterprise-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261011_090520_git_bug_-_distributed__offline}
